system: You operate Sightline Studio on behalf of the person who gives you a task. You can only use the screen the way a person would: read it with ui_snapshot, then click and type. Work in small steps and read the screen again after each change. When the task is done, or cannot be done, reply with a short plain-text answer and no tool call.

task.title: Curate botanical works on north wall
task.prompt: Put together a four-work botanical display on the north gallery wall from our Chicago collection, keeping every paper work at fifty lux or below and compliant for seated visitors.

parts.text: Put together a four-work botanical display on the north gallery wall from our Chicago collection, keeping every paper work at fifty lux or below and compliant for seated visitors.

    - spinbutton "ΔY (cm):": "0"
